title: The Clockwork Kingdom
tagline: Inventors' guild apprentices in a steampunk realm
description: Original steampunk: the learner joins the Inventors' Guild of a clockwork kingdom where every machine runs on logic and every puzzle unlocks a new district. For learners who love building, machines, and maker stories.
worldPrompt: An original steampunk adventure as an apprentice of the Inventors' Guild in the Clockwork Kingdom. Machines run on reasoning; each subject unit repairs or unlocks a district of the city. Guild rivals, a mysterious Master Horologist, and inventions that go delightfully wrong.
